Money per resident. For each municipio, the dollars of each program from 2017 to 2025 are added, then divided by its residents in the 2020 Census. Public Assistance: federal share obligated, by applicant and the year the disaster was declared. Individual Assistance: dollars approved for owners and renters, by the year the disaster was declared. Hazard Mitigation: federal share approved, by benefiting municipio and fiscal year of the grant. The three FEMA programs together add the three; approved and obligated are different steps, so the sum is a rough total. HUD CDBG-DR and CDBG-MIT: the subawards of the Department of Housing's disaster grants, by the municipio where the work is done and the federal fiscal year of the obligation. HUD yearly CDBG: the entitlement grants by the municipio that receives them, plus the state program's subawards by municipio, by federal fiscal year of the obligation; COVID-19 grants (CDBG-CV) are left out.

HUD's Community Development Block Grants reach Puerto Rico in three ways. The disaster recovery and mitigation grants (CDBG-DR and CDBG-MIT) go to the Puerto Rico Department of Housing: HUD obligated $19.10 billion of them in federal fiscal years 2019 to 2025, and the Department reported $4.90 billion in subawards to municipalities, contractors and nonprofits, $4.33 billion of it with a municipio. The yearly grants go straight from HUD to 27 larger municipios (entitlement grants, $222 million) and, for the other municipios, to the Department of Housing as the state program ($160 million), which passes it on as subawards. Subawards often arrive a year or more after the grant, so the latest year can show little. Obligated is not spent. Select a column heading to sort.

HUD's grants are placed through the subawards the Puerto Rico Department of Housing reports, and the yearly entitlement grants through the municipio that receives them. Money the Department keeps for its own programs, has not passed on yet, or reports with no municipio is not placed.

The page also shows HUD's Community Development Block Grants (CDBG): the disaster recovery and mitigation grants (CDBG-DR and CDBG-MIT) and the yearly grants, as obligated in federal fiscal years 2019 to 2025. HUD's money is never added to FEMA's: the years are counted differently. Pick it under Money, or see section 4.
